title: Retinal Cell Death Protocol
author: David A. Antonetti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yaafsae
materials: Homogenize the retina and keep it on ice
Carefully remove the solution by aspiration

steps.title: Prepare and Weigh Retina Sample
steps.instruction: Obtain the retinal weight by weighing the retina sample with the tube.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Freeze the retina in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C, or use fresh retina.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Lyse the retina samples to extract proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl 1x Lysis buffer to each mouse retina
Vortex and incubate the sample at room temperature for 30 minutes with gentle rocking
Centrifuge at 12500 rpm at 4ºC for 10 minutes
Collect the supernatant in a fresh tube and save the pellet

steps.title: Plate Loading
steps.instruction: Load samples and controls into the plate in triplicates.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µl of samples, positive control (supplied in kit), and blank or negative control (lysis buffer) into each well

steps.title: Immuno-reagent Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply immuno-reagent and incubate the plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µl of Immuno reagent to each well
Cover the plate with an adhesive strip and foil
Incubate with gentle shaking (300 rpm) at room temperature for 2 hours

steps.title: Plate Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the wells to remove unbound reagents.

substeps.instruction: Fill each well with 200 µl of incubation buffer 1x (bottle #4) using a multi-channel pipette
Repeat the washing process for a total of 5 washes

steps.title: Color Development
steps.instruction: Develop the color signal using ABTS solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of ABTS Solution to each well
Incubate on a plate shaker, protecting from light, until color develops (approximately 10 min)
Add 100 µl of ABTS stop solution to each well
Gently tap the plate to ensure thorough mixing

steps.title: Plate Reading
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the plate.

substeps.instruction: Read the plate within 30 minutes at 405 nm
Use ABTS solution plus 100 µl of ABTS stop solution as the blank
